first.rationale: I intend to test shorter, simpler onboarding because onboarding completion is down 4% and activation is down 6%, while prior evidence indicates onboarding improvements can increase time-to-value and completion and activation messaging can improve week-one engagement. I would keep this as a small guarded test with stop conditions on qualified activation, retention, and pipeline quality so a top-of-funnel lift does not mask weaker downstream value. I am not prioritizing promotional pricing because prior evidence shows retention damage despite acquisition and revenue gains.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding, prioritizing the current 4% completion decline and the strongest verified downstream evidence: shorter onboarding increased completion 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and improved 30-day retention by 3%. Monitor qualified activation, retention, and revenue quality with explicit stop conditions; do not assume completion gains automatically translate to sustainable revenue. Activation messaging is a credible fallback, but its verified retention lift was smaller.
